title: Schur positivity from signed elementary expansions: clique-spiders and spiders $S(a,b,2)$
summary: Determining when the chromatic symmetric function of a graph is Schur positive is a central problem in algebraic combinatorics. Elementary expansions can help answer this question, but negative coefficients obstruct a direct positivity argument. We develop methods for proving Schur positivity from signed elementary expansions and apply them to chromatic symmetric functions of clique-spiders and three-legged spiders.
